_about: FundTruth claim register (ESG promises module). Each fund's ESG promises were extracted with an LLM from the issuer's public fund page on 2026-11-13. 'quotes' are verbatim from the page; 'fossil_promise' is our structured reading of those quotes: 'full' = the fund promises to exclude oil, gas and coal producers or owners of their reserves; 'reduced' = it promises lower carbon exposure than the market; 'partial' = it excludes only thermal coal and/or oil sands; 'none' = no fossil promise. Expense ratios are those shown on the cited pages on that date. UK-listed funds (London Stock Exchange) are analysed in GBP: USD- and EUR-quoted series are converted with the GBP/USD and EUR/GBP rates.

SPYX.name: SPDR S&P 500 Fossil Fuel Reserves Free ETF
SPYX.index: S&P 500 Fossil Fuel Reserves Free Index
SPYX.parent_name: SPDR S&P 500 ETF (same parent index, no exclusions)
quotes: eliminating companies that own fossil fuel reserves from the S&P 500

fossil fuel reserves are defined as (i) thermal coal reserves, (ii) other non-metallurgical coal reserves (iii) conventional or unconventional oil reserves (iv) natural gas reserves, (v) shale gas reserves
